title: Disappointed
text: This app was recommended by a friend who is an Apple Store specialist. I see all of the positive reviews and happy to see that it works for most. I had over 13000 contacts due to yeas of duplicating contacts in various syncs. Finally I though here’s a solution. It’s not a true merge. If can’t combine same numbers with different names, you have to manually edit and or delete one. That’s fine when you have a couple. But I have 160. I’ll have to go through each one manually. If I’m paying for Pro, why isn’t there a feature that lets you choose which duplicate you want to keep if some of the info is different. Notes didn’t transfer for me so I did loose a lot of important information. I may restore from a back up and start over with a new app. If you’re just merging duplicate names with different numbers, it works brilliantly in minutes. If you have more complicated duplicates (30 years of digital contacts) this is not the app for you. Good luck.
